answer: Cryptographic proof-of-stake defends an economy of autonomous agents against Sybil attacks by requiring each node to stake native capital to participate in consensus. An attacker attempting to fracture network truth through a vast plume of generated identities faces immense financial ruin, as every fraudulent node incurs an identical staking cost. This economic prism refracts protocol rewards while isolating malicious clusters, ensuring that systemic validation power scales strictly with locked wealth rather than mere algorithmic replication across a digital grove.
